title: VethuQ policy payload (schema v1)
description: The payload carried inside the signed envelope. Changes within schema major 1 are additive only; clients MUST ignore unknown fields, so additionalProperties is intentionally left open everywhere.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Always 1 for payloads served from /v1/.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number. Clients reject a policy whose sequence is lower than the last one they accepted (rollback protection).

issued_at.description: UTC time the policy was signed (RFC 3339).

kid.description: Id of the signing key. Must equal the kid in the envelope.

versions.description: Latest and minimum supported versions per distribution.

addon_api.description: Inclusive add-on API version range supported by the latest release.

notices.description: User-facing notices. A notice is shown only inside its optional starts_at/ends_at window.

features.description: Feature flags keyed by flag name. Setting enabled=false is also the remote kill switch for a feature.

limits.description: Time-boxed limit adjustments and promotions. Structure only; empty in the initial v1 policies.

effective_from.description: Optional UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD). Rate and limit sections in this payload (rate_card, wallets, caps, grace_percent, grace_mode, metrics, ocr) take effect at the later of this date and the next UTC day boundary after the client first saw the policy. Never earlier than the next boundary: the day in progress keeps the rates it started with. Promotions follow their own whole-day windows instead.

applies_to.description: Optional client-version scope for the whole payload's rate and limit sections. Absent means all client versions. A section may carry its own applies_to, which replaces this one for that section.

rate_card.description: The credit rate card. Rates are the same for every client version unless applies_to says otherwise. The package keeps a baseline that is used until a policy is available or when this section is absent.

wallets.description: Daily and starter credits per wallet. Absent values mean the package baseline applies.

promotions.description: Credit promotions over whole UTC days. The highest uplift per wallet applies (non-stacking), capped by caps.

caps.description: Upper limits clients enforce on promotions, one-off credits, the daily device ceiling and the metrics bonus.

grace_percent.description: Grace allowance as a percentage of a wallet's daily allowance, used only after all other credits are exhausted. Default 2.

grace_mode.description: free: used grace is not charged back. borrow: used grace is deducted from the next day. Default free. Clients ignore an unknown value and use the default.

ocr.description: OCR engine settings delivered by policy.

revoked_key_ids.description: Signing key ids the client must stop trusting, at once and permanently. Honoured only when the envelope was signed by a key in the client's embedded policy-standby set; the signing key itself and standby keys can never be listed. See docs/schema-v1.md, 'Key revocation'.

revoked_licence_ids.description: Licence ids that no longer unlock add-ons. A licensed add-on refuses a licence listed here. The list only matters while a licence is unexpired, so ids may be dropped once their licences have expired. Clients that don't understand the field ignore it.

addons.description: Per add-on policy keyed by add-on id (for example backup): the latest and minimum supported add-on version, and a remote kill switch.

minimum_supported.description: Clients older than this are told they must update.

downloads.description: Per-platform download entries. Used by the desktop distribution; pip normally omits it.

platform.description: Platform identifier, e.g. windows-x64, macos-arm64, linux-x64.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file.

id.description: Stable id so clients can remember a dismissed notice.

min_client.description: The flag applies only to clients at or above this version.

adjustments.description: Named adjustments applied while the window is active, e.g. {"max_vaults": 10}.

utc_date.description: A calendar date in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD. Whole UTC days; impossible dates are rejected by validation.

credits.description: A non-negative number of credits, with at most 3 decimal places (clients convert to integer millicredits).

applies_to.description: Optional scope. client: inclusive client-version range (either bound may be omitted; absent means all versions). tiers and addons: entitlement filters, meaningful on promotions only. Unknown members are ignored.

version.description: Rate card version, stamped on every ledger row. Increases whenever any rate changes.

page_size.description: Credits per page = page area / A4 area, rounded up to `step` after `tolerance_percent`, at least `minimum`; pages above `per_page_max` are refused.

pixels.description: Credits for images = processed pixels / reference megapixels (A4 at 300 dpi), rounded up to `step`, at least `minimum`.

phases.description: Credits per A4 page added by each OCR phase (upright, one language). quick is the first pass; moderate and high add rotated passes.

rotated_factor.description: Multiplier for each rotated angle pass (a pricing discount, not the compute cost).

language_pass.description: Credits per page per additional language (upright).

semantic.description: Credits per page for semantic embedding, charged from the semantic sub-wallet.

device_multiplier.description: Multiplier by compute device actually used.

model_multiplier.description: Multiplier by OCR model profile. fast is 1.0; advanced is set when the advanced profile is priced.

github.description: The client picks daily_private or daily_public from the visibility of the runner repo it checks before each job.

addons.description: Add-on sub-wallets keyed by add-on id (for example semantic). Usable only for that add-on's work.

start_date.description: First UTC day of the window (inclusive).

end_date.description: Last UTC day of the window (inclusive).

uplift.description: Per wallet, added to that wallet's daily allowance on each day inside the window. Wallet keys: local, github, or addon:<id>. Each value has exactly one of absolute (credits) or percent.

promotion_uplift_percent.description: Maximum percent uplift a promotion may give one wallet.

one_off_max.description: Maximum one-off credits held at once.

device_daily_ceiling.description: Absolute daily credits one device can receive from all sources.

bonus_percent.description: Percent added to the daily credits of the local and GitHub wallets while sharing is on and the last send was within 7 days. Default 10; capped by caps.metrics_bonus_percent.

profiles.description: Override of the model profile per phase, for example all fast as a kill switch for the advanced models. Absent phases use the client's default.

enabled.description: false is the remote kill switch: the add-on stops doing its work (it never deletes data). Absent means enabled.

minimum_supported.description: Installed add-on versions older than this are told to update.

min_client.description: The entry applies only to clients at or above this version.
